proof_limits: Watertight consistent positive-volume pieces are not self-intersection/connection/rigidity acceptance. All checked left pieces have one positive material component; negative closed cavities are not material islands. Right geometry is constructed by reflection, right metadata needs repair.
Endpoint neutral and unloaded fold only; no continuous swept collision test.
Two16mm locks double shear S355 yield FS2 is gross ideal 82419.043N per brace, not an OEM or complete joint capacity; bearing, ligament, eye pins, buckling, welds, preload, retention unknown.

Brace equal sagittal sharing is assumed and cannot certify 3D roll/torsion distribution. Endpoint-driven barrel/plunger mass attachment is a proxy, not independently proved loop reaction/generalized gravity equivalence.
Gravity-only upward contact and finite selected pressure/density hypotheses; no dynamics, friction, thermal, manufacturing or high-mass-range acceptance.
